Hi Glen — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/finance so we can move to PO: 

1) Tax classification: finance needs us to record whether NovaPay will be treated as a foreign entity subject to withholding (W-8BEN-E) or if there is a US-taxable branch (W-9). From your note it sounds like W-8BEN-E is correct. Marcus, can you confirm whether the attached W-8BEN-E is sufficient for our payment flows or whether we need additional treaty certificates?

2) Signatory proof: the CFO signature is okay, but Legal sometimes asks for a short signatory authority memo or a scanned passport for the signatory if the bank letter is not notarized. Are you able to either: 
   - supply a short board resolution/scoped signatory memo, or
   - provide a notarized bank letter?

3) Bank letter: procurement requires the bank letter to include account holder name + IBAN/SWIFT and an on-bank-letterhead confirmation of existence dated within 90 days. The copy you sent looks good but can you confirm the issue date (I see 2027-07-01 on the filename).

Once Finance confirms tax treatment and we have signatory proof, we can create the PO and route for signatures. If any part is time-sensitive for you, call out the delivery timeline and we will prioritize.

Thanks — I will keep you posted.
